description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PimCsvDataImportServiceTest' that tests the functionality of the 'PimCsvDataImportService' class related to importing CSV data for Employee records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for various scenarios (successful import, duplicates, invalid data), and uses mocking for external services.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PimCsvDataImportService functions related to CSV import of employee data.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Static method to populate test data prior to running tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, truncating specific tables.

methods.name: testGetCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Test if the method getCsvDataImportService returns an instance of CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: testImport
methods.description: Test successful import of CSV data mapping to employee records.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateEmployeeId
methods.description: Test import handling of duplicate employee IDs.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Test import with invalid first and last names to verify validation handling.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Test import with invalid license expiry dates.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidMaritalStatus
methods.description: Test import with invalid marital status entries.

methods.name: testImportWithNationality
methods.description: Test import with nationality data included.

methods.name: testImportWithContactDetails
methods.description: Test import with contact detail fields.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMailForSameEmployee
methods.description: Test duplicate email addresses assigned to the same employee.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMail
methods.description: Test different employees sharing email addresses.

methods.name: testImportWithoutFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Test import behavior when first or last names are missing or invalid.
